# testing_x_additional_properties_name (Resource)

XAdditionalPropertiesName Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_additional_properties_name" "my_xadditionalpropertiesname" {
  id                           = "...my_id..."
  slug                         = "...my_slug..."
  string                       = "...my_string..."
  x_additional_properties_name = "{ \"see\": \"documentation\" }"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Additional parameter to verify operations scope request type handling

### Optional

- `string` (String) String property outside of additionalProperties
- `x_additional_properties_name` (String) Parsed as JSON.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_additional_properties_name.my_testing_x_additional_properties_name
  id = jsonencode({
    id   = "..."
    slug = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_additional_properties_name.my_testing_x_additional_properties_name '{"id": "...", "slug": "..."}'
```
